summary: EDAP TMS S.A. (FocalTherics) filed a preliminary prospectus supplement to a shelf registration for a proposed follow-on offering of American Depositary Shares (ADSs). Each ADS represents one ordinary share, currently trading at $6.08 per ADS as of August 10, 2026, on the Nasdaq Global Market. The offering size, price, and underwriter discounts are left blank as the supplement is subject to completion. Joint book-running managers include TD Cowen and Mizuho, with H.C. Wainwright and Lucid Capital Markets as co-managers. The underwriters have a 30-day option to purchase additional ADSs. This is a routine capital raise, not a special situation.
